probes.name: Homes sold in period
probes.note: The §8a.8 row label. The table lane abstains here with AMBIGUOUS_ALIAS over four concepts because the whole label matches no alias and the widest surface inside it is the declared-ambiguous “homes”. The scope keeps all four and additionally records `homes_sold` as the one whose own name is present, which is the evidence a narrative lane needs and a deterministic reader is not entitled to act on.
